notes: Repo has .gitmodules. Submodule commits were not vendored; submodule URLs remain in the tree.

Delta bundle contains this fork's diverging commits and tags. Prerequisite cd2241e6e2c4d3f0b3d0e1e202c999a4ac782cf3 must come from https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco (still public on the capture date; compare ahead 32). A full standalone bundle was not stored because the fork is a 173880 KB copy of that upstream.
description: Imitation learning benchmark focusing on complex locomotion tasks using MuJoCo.
